### Added
- Seven components, off by default — the extras the [agent-platform-standalone](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform-standalone) umbrella carried as Helm dependencies on top of this roster, so a cluster with none of them turns them on from the same `components:` map: `components.backstage` (the Giant Swarm Backstage portal, `0.x`), `components.mcp-kubernetes` (`>=1.1.1 <2.0.0`, the `global.identity` fallbacks its block relies on), `components.cloudnative-pg` (the upstream CloudNativePG operator from `oci://ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/charts`, `0.29.x` — one chart minor is one operator line and an operator upgrade rolls every instance pod, so moving it is a deliberate edit) and the four KServe charts `components.kserve-crd`, `components.kserve-resources`, `components.kserve-llmisvc-crd`, `components.kserve-llmisvc-resources` (`0.2.x`, one repository, moving together). Each is rendered by the existing loop as one `OCIRepository` + `HelmRelease`; the new top-level blocks `backstage:`, `mcp-kubernetes:`, `cloudnative-pg:`, `kserve-crd:`, `kserve-resources:`, `kserve-llmisvc-crd:`, `kserve-llmisvc-resources:` carry the standalone's defaults (Backstage's chart Ingress and VPA off, the base config restated, the Agent Platform app-config mounted from `agent-platform-backstage-app-config`, the credentials Secret and optional identity-provider CA from `global.identity`; mcp-kubernetes as an OAuth 2.1 resource server acting as the user with downstream OAuth; KServe in Standard deployment mode without per-model routes; the llm-d controller reusing the shared objects) and are forwarded verbatim with `global` injected. `dependsOn` replaces the standalone's two-phase first-install guard: `kserve-resources` after `kserve-crd`, `kserve-llmisvc-resources` after `kserve-crd`, `kserve-llmisvc-crd` and `kserve-resources`, `backstage` after `cloudnative-pg`, and the CR consumers `agent-platform-connectivity` (the CNPG `Cluster`, the model serving objects) after `cloudnative-pg` and `kserve-resources`, `model-manager` after `kserve-resources` — every reference dropped at render time while the component is off, as before. None of the seven ships a `crds/` dir (kserve-crd, kserve-llmisvc-crd and cloudnative-pg render their CRDs as templates, upgraded with the release), so none carries a `crds:` policy. `kserve-llmisvc-crd` is a component the standalone could not have: its 4.5 MB of CRDs did not fit in the umbrella's one release Secret; as its own release it does. `examples/customer-bom.yaml` pins all seven (the standalone's tested pins). The roster forwarded to the connectivity release carries the seven flags, so the wiring the standalone rendered by hand for them (the Backstage app-config and route, the mcp-kubernetes `MCPServer`, the model serving runtimes) can gate on them when it moves into the connectivity chart in a following release; the connectivity chart declares the seven roster entries and the seven blocks already. `make verify-components` asserts the roster (off by default, sources, ranges, order, BOM pins, the forwarded tree against the connectivity schema, schema symmetry between the two charts); `make verify-components-charts` pulls the seven charts at the range's resolution and at the BOM pin and renders each with the forwarded values. **No installation needs to act**: the fleet render changes by the seven `<name>: {enabled: false}` roster lines inside the connectivity `HelmRelease`'s values only — one Helm revision of that release with unchanged objects and no pod rolled.
- `components.<name>.omitKeys` applies to a `forwardAllValues` component too, dropping top-level blocks from the forwarded tree. `components.agent-platform-connectivity.omitKeys` holds the seven new blocks back from the connectivity release until its wiring reads them: that chart's root schema is `additionalProperties: false`, and while both charts release off one tag, the fleet's connectivity release re-resolves its chart on its own `OCIRepository` interval — a block the live chart does not declare would fail that release on every installation until the chart caught up. The release that adds the wiring drops the blocks from the list; the connectivity `values.yaml` declares them from this release on, so that step has no such window.
